eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Barry; Berrien; Cass; Kalamazoo; St. Joseph; Van Buren, MI; at 11:52 PM on AUG 29, 2018 Effective until 1:52 AM AUG 30, 2018. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: AMBER ALERT BEING ISSUED FOR STURGIS PD FOR 3 CHILDREN TAKEN BY THEIR FATHER AFTER ASSAULTING THE MOTHER OF THE CHILDREN.  THE FATHER FERNANDO CRUZ IS ARMED WITH HANDGUN.
